description: One verification result notice from the external provider (G-164). Only the decision fields are kept. Document images and face data never reach this record. The server writes these records; no role writes them by hand.

fields.description: The provider's event id. It is unique, so the same notice is stored once.
fields.label: Event ID

fields.description: The verification case the notice is about.
fields.label: Case ID

fields.description: The attempt number of the case. Only the newest attempt can decide.
fields.label: Attempt

fields.description: The result the provider sent: approved, rejected or review. It decides only if the attempt is the newest one.
fields.label: Outcome

fields.description: pending: waiting for the queue job. The other values say what the job did.
fields.label: State

name: PLT Verification Notice
